applicability.full_trigger_absence_proof: No full assessment trigger applies. This is one bounded correction to an unshipped verification script, introduces no abstraction, module, class, interface, or public API, and does not match public_api. It adds only Git configuration to a temporary clone and direct flags to one commit inside it, so it changes no integration, lifecycle_or_state, concurrency, persistence, or security_sensitive_behavior. It touches no governance_core_path. Kit contents, identity, and digests are unchanged, and no requirement text or canonical capability requirement changes.

security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, kit identity calculation, checksum list, or integrity assertion changes; the correction only configures a disposable clone.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization mechanism changes; the temporary clone workflow makes no principal, permission, or access-control decision.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, signature, provenance field, owner decision, or release authorization changes; clone-local Git settings are transient.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction prevents an uncontrolled detached Git writer in a temporary clone but adds no scheduler, lock, shared state, or concurrent coordination behavior.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret, credential, or confidential payload handling changes; configuration values and diagnostics concern only disposable local Git state.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, digest calculation, key handling, signing, or verification behavior changes; kit digests remain unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No diagnostic surface changes; an existing clone-removal failure remains loud without exposing kit contents, credentials, or additional data.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, network service, exporter, collector deployment, or third-party security integration is introduced or changed.
security_justification.fail_posture: The gate prevents the known background writer before it starts and retains the existing loud failure for any other clone-removal problem.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, sink, operation, package, or release lifecycle transition changes; the configuration exists only for one disposable clone lifetime.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The change writes Git configuration only inside a fresh temporary clone while the live repository remains read-only and removal remains explicit.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transformation, data classification, redaction, prohibited-data scan, or personal-data processing behavior changes.
security_justification.resource_retention: No storage or retention policy changes; the affected Git configuration is contained in a temporary clone that the existing remover deletes.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queueing, or attempt behavior changes; removal retries are expressly rejected by this correction.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The existing repository and local temporary-directory boundaries remain unchanged; no principal, external system, or trust crossing is added.
